name: Jaakobah
overview: Jaakobah is a male figure identified as a member of the tribe of Simeon according to 1 Chronicles 4:36. Beyond his tribal affiliation and gender, little else is recorded about him, leaving his unique attributes largely unspecified.
namesAndTitles: The name Jaakobah means 'may [deity] protect,' reflecting a theistic invocation common in Hebrew names. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a protective connotation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jaakobah as a descendant of Simeon, linking him directly to the tribe of Simeon. No other familial relationships or genealogical details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Jaakobah's mention in 1 Chronicles 4:36 situates him within the genealogical records that affirm the continuity of the tribe of Simeon. While the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal role or deeds, his inclusion underscores the importance of preserving the lineage of God's chosen tribes as part of the broader redemptive history.
